entities.name: Bruna
entities.description: Angel of Innistrad, leader of the Flight of Alabaster, later eldrazified by Emrakul.

entities.name: Flight of Alabaster
entities.description: Angels personifying the Blessed Sleep who ward against desecration of the dead.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: Angel, sister of Bruna, who killed Brisela.

entities.name: Liesa
entities.description: Angel sister who consorted with demons and was executed by Avacyn.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Archangel the four sisters deferred to; later corrupted and killed.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Planeswalker who summoned Emrakul into Innistrad.

entities.name: Brisela
entities.description: Horrific amalgamation of Bruna and Gisela enforcing Emrakul's will.

events.summary: Avacyn executed Liesa in a righteous fury while Bruna and her sisters stood aside.
events.quote: Bruna and her sisters stood aside when Avacyn executed Liesa in a righteous fury

events.summary: After Avacyn's corruption Bruna went on a crusade to wipe out humanity.
events.quote: going off on a crusade to wipe out humanity

events.summary: Bruna and Gisela tried to intimidate Sigarda into allying with them.
events.quote: trying to intimidate her into allying herself with them

events.summary: Nahiri summoned Emrakul, which mutated Bruna and Gisela into Brisela; Sigarda killed Brisela.

relations.quote: She was the leader of the Flight of Alabaster .
Bruna, Gisela , Sigarda , and Liesa are described as sisters
